doc: V[N-1][a][q]: echo pulse damage per second in units of S (tools/echo_table.py); isolated[N-1][q]: pulse damage of one lone echo chain, so V ~ a x isolated below the grid
doc_reverb: v_reverb[N-1][a][q]: Reverberating Echo damage per second in units of S (tools/echo_table.py --reverb, 60000 procs per cell); V ~ a^2 below the grid (a reverberation needs a live echo when the next proc lands)
